_description: Golden coding-session dataset for ExtractCodingMemory regression testing. Each conversation is an agent-session transcript with a session context (branch, task, files) and hand-labeled expected coding memory: decisions, gotchas, dead ends, and preferences. Expected items match extracted output via case-insensitive regex (*_contains fields); anchors_include lists files that must appear in the matched item's anchor_files.

context.task: MUD-410: unblock the event loop in the API client

conversations.transcript:
User: The API calls are blocking the event loop in src/api/client.py. Fix it.

Assistant: I read src/api/client.py - it calls requests inside async handlers. I decided to switch the module to httpx's AsyncClient instead of requests, because requests has no async support, so every call blocks the event loop. Public function signatures stay unchanged.

[Edit src/api/client.py: replace requests.Session with httpx.AsyncClient]

Assistant: The first test run failed with a stale timeout. Gotcha in src/config/settings.py: the module caches environment variables at import time, so setting HTTP_TIMEOUT after the import has no effect - tests must patch the environment before importing settings.

Assistant: I tried passing pool_size directly to the ApiClient constructor in src/api/client.py to fix the connection-limit errors, but that failed: the connection pool is created before the settings object loads, so the argument is ignored. Abandoning that approach and configuring limits on the shared AsyncClient instead.

User: Makes sense. Also, going forward use pytest fixtures instead of setUp methods in tests/test_client.py - I prefer fixtures for all test setup.

Assistant: Noted. I rewrote tests/test_client.py around a pytest fixture for the client and all tests pass.
